**Source** [Rusthenge](/Sources.aspx?ID=215) pg. 48 **Complexity** Simple As the large rusty door swings open, a mass of rusty spikes appear out of nowhere in the open doorway and launch violently into the room. --- **Stealth** DC 20 (trained) **Disable** DC 20 [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) to decouple the triggering rods that cause the spikes to extend, or [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=78) (2nd level; [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) DC 18) to counteract the trap **Launch Spikes** **Trigger** a creature opens the door without uttering a prayer to Xar-Azmak first; **Effect** A mass of rusty spikes appears in the open doorway and then fire into area **E1**. The rusty spikes curve through the air to seek targets—all creatures in area **E1** must attempt a DC 20 Reflex save. **Critical Success** The creature avoids the spikes and takes no damage.
**Success** A spike grazes the creature, inflicting 2d10 piercing damage.
**Failure** A spike impales the creature, inflicting 2d10+13 piercing damage.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but the spike also exposes the creature to [tetanus](/Diseases.aspx?ID=3). --- **Reset** The trap automatically resets once the door is closed.
name: Rusty Spike Launcher
reset: The trap automatically resets once the door is closed.
